announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM date following the November capital raise. This routine governance filing confirms meeting logistics for existing investors.

announcements.insight: Welsh hospitals extend routine testing. This follows earlier implementation in the Netherlands and PALOH-UK recruitment completion, indicating ongoing commercial adoption.

announcements.insight: ShareSoc presentation follows recent board changes and recruitment completion. Shareholders should monitor for strategic updates linked to these governance and operational milestones.
